title: muse2api (iLang one-click distribution)
description:
muse2api serves the chat, image and video generation of the muse.ai web app as an OpenAI-compatible HTTP API on the user's own server, with a pool of the user's own muse.ai accounts that are rotated and kept alive.

This distribution keeps the upstream MUSE2API code (MIT, MUSE2API Authors) unchanged and adds three things: install.sh, a one-line installer for Ubuntu and Debian servers that installs Docker from the official repository when missing, deploys, upgrades in place on re-run, and optionally serves the API on a domain with nginx and a Let's Encrypt certificate, without touching sshd, logins or the firewall; install.md, an iLang v5.0 engineering book that lets any AI agent able to run shell commands (on the user's computer or on its own cloud computer) deploy the service, let the user import accounts by logging in to muse.ai personally, and verify the result with code-checked acceptance items; and agent instruction files (AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md).

Release 1.6.12-ilang.1 (2026-11-23) is based on upstream v1.6.12. Tested on Ubuntu 24.04 x86_64: fresh install, in-place upgrade, refusal of a second install, domain with https and back to plain IP; the same deployment and account import were run end to end by a Grok Bot following the book. Not tested: Debian, arm64, servers whose ports 80 and 443 are held by a hosting panel.
